== Course of events ==

After the Cowardly Lion receives a green liquid from Oz to drink as his courage, the Scarecrow comes before Oz to receive his promised brains. Oz removes the Scarecrow's head, fills it with bran mixed with pins and needles, and reattaches it, granting the Scarecrow the brains he had been promised.

With the Scarecrow's request fulfilled, the Tin Woodman is next to go to Oz to receive his promised heart. Oz then turns his attention to preparing for his departure: a clothes basket is fastened to a balloon, and he announces to the crowd that he is visiting a brother Wizard in the clouds, while Dorothy and Oz spend days sewing green silk strips together and coating the balloon with glue for airtightness.
